results.content: Publication : I’m pleased to share a recently published Sector Feature in Islamic Finance News (IFN) titled “A Continuum of Care: Supporting the Elderly Today While Preparing the Youth for Tomorrow.” Authored by Dr Amelia Nur Natasha Nazeri and co-authored by me, the article explores the growing importance of waqf-based solutions in addressing Malaysia’s ageing population, while simultaneously empowering the younger generation to support sustainable and inclusive social and economic development. 📘 What my research covers: • Why Sukuk and Islamic funds are not yet mainstream in India  • Legal and regulatory barriers (including the RBI's 2015 position)  • Lessons from non-Muslim countries  • Practical, regulation-friendly steps India can take  • Real Indian initiatives in Shariah-compliant equity investing and interest-free cooperative finance This paper is written for:  ✔ Economics & finance students  ✔ Market professionals  ✔ Policy & regulatory enthusiasts  ✔ Anyone curious about alternative capital market structures  I'd love to receive feedback, counterarguments, or discussions.
